principles: Metadata provenance and structural identity decide retention, never filename alone.
Canonical closeout writes may move HEAD but cannot weaken review of unchanged material.
Any uncertain or material drift executes or re-reviews rather than inheriting PASS.
drivers: Eliminate repeated metadata-only review rounds in unattended workflows.
Preserve fail-closed security and assurance semantics.
Keep writer, phase, prompt, handler, gate, and process registry mechanically aligned.

options.name: A: shared closeout lineage contract plus convergent ordering
pros: One source of truth for artifact writer and lineage
Covers all existing and future registered closeout artifacts

options.name: B: reorder commands only
cons: Delivery or future artifact writes can recreate the loop
Does not solve concept false positives

options.name: C: whitelist artifacts at each gate

chosen: A: shared closeout lineage contract plus convergent ordering
rationale: Choose A because the failure spans writer receipts, review-run validation, lifecycle readiness, dispatch phases, and transition ordering. A registry-driven contract removes the class while keeping non-canonical and material drift fail-closed.

preMortem.scenario: A forged closeout file preserves stale review
preMortem.trigger: Retention trusts path without canonical writer receipt or signature
preMortem.mitigation: Require registry membership, canonical writer, receipt integrity, structural hashes, and trusted metadata-only lineage; add tamper and unknown-writer negatives.

preMortem.scenario: One-pass test passes only because gates were weakened
preMortem.trigger: Review freshness ignores storyFilesHash, policy, or command-set drift
preMortem.mitigation: Add explicit source, config, policy, command-set, and story-owned drift matrix asserting blocking.

preMortem.trigger: Dispatch and mutation policies continue to allow different phases
preMortem.consequence: Delivery must be signed in an order that invalidates reviewer passes
preMortem.mitigation: Derive both dispatch and writer phase admission from one lane policy and exercise full REVIEW to DONE transcript.

preMortem.scenario: Concept gate stops detecting true deletions
preMortem.trigger: Body-edit false-positive fix filters too broadly
preMortem.consequence: Removed declarations with residual references pass
preMortem.mitigation: Test unchanged declaration body edit, signature edit, true deletion, rename, overload, and residual reference cases separately.
